description: This file defines a full-screen video player page in a Flutter application, using the 'video_player' package to control video playback and integrating provider for state management.

classes.name: VideoPlayerScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that provides a route to the full-screen video player page, expects a VideoItem as a parameter.

classes.name: _VideoPlayerPage
classes.description: A stateful widget managing the full-screen video playback, including initialization and user interface.

classes.name: _VideoPlayerPageState
classes.description: State class for _VideoPlayerPage, responsible for initializing the video and building the UI.

methods.name: route
methods.description: Creates a route to navigate to the video player page with the provided VideoItem.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the full-screen video player, showing a loading indicator if the controller isn't initialized.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers video playback once the widget is inserted into the tree.
